world_note: 100% invented SaaS world. Brands: TravelPro, AcmeRoast, NorthPeak. All domains under *.larkfield.example. Zero bytes copied from AutomationBench, Harvey, the Amazon ESCI dataset, or any customer data. The scoring engine re-implements upstream mechanism only; see LICENSE-FIXTURES.md.
sha256_note: sha256 values are placeholders ('PENDING') in this P0 prototype. Compute with `shasum -a 256 <path>` (or `python3 -c "import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()).hexdigest())" <path>`) and replace before any release. Recoverability-gate results are produced by `env/run_eval.py --validate-all`.
